report_metadata.summary: Implements Argon's Phase-4 residual audit (F-01..F-05). Whole-group weighted Kabsch fit halves the buster leg PASS4 plateau (0.25m -> 0.10m worst probe); WARN_NONRIGID_CHAIN now reports interior_dev/endpoint_dev with split recommendations; FK_SCISSOR_CLIP surfaces 41 real tri-tri joint crossings on the mech that vert-enclosure was structurally blind to; motion-progress repose ramp + PASS4/PASS3c truth conjugation verified phantom-free on a synthetic 15deg rest_rot; rigid-SE3 carrier relativization; chained-quat manifest field. PASS3b untouched (0.0000-0.0001).

visual_evidence.mount_gap_check: deployed render compared against testing/buster_PHASE4_deployed_iso.png -- hip mounts identical, no proximal-joint gap introduced by the 3x proximal-weighted fit
visual_evidence.render_note: renders are vertex-colour flat-shaded assembly checks (render_check convention), not textured output

synthetic_rest_rot_15deg_panel_l.repose_ramp: 0 -> 1.0 completes at t=0.270 (deployment-complete, no stationary-tail twist)

findings_resolved.what: Multi-member groups now drive from a whole-group weighted Kabsch delta T'_k (V_rel(0)->V_rel(k), det<0 reflection fix, driver member weight 3x normalized) instead of the single driver matrix. Endpoint epsilon-snap (<1e-4 m/rad) keeps rigid-group manifests bit-identical; fitted groups emit fit-based deployed_* matching keyframes[-1] exactly.
findings_resolved.measured: leg_l/r worst PASS4 probe 0.25m -> 0.10-0.11m; residual is permanent non-rigidity, not interpolation error
findings_resolved.remaining: endpoint_dev 0.31-0.47m on leg chains is a permanent deployed-pose error inside the joined .ydr -- only fixable by part_map split (max_parts headroom needed)

findings_resolved.what: FK_SCISSOR_CLIP in rigid_plate_qa.fk_sweep_penetration: lazy posed BVHTree per (pose, moved island), BVHTree.overlap tri-tri pairs vs rest islands under the same rest_touch + 0.02m AABB prefilter. _vert_enclosed unchanged (54->0 open-shell filtering preserved).
findings_resolved.measured: 41 crossings on the mech, all at plausible joints: calf->thigh at knee (+25deg), thigh->pelvis, foot->foot
findings_resolved.open: 41 scissor clips need design review -- knee/hip plate interpenetration at 25deg flex may be real rig clipping (would show in-game) or acceptable design overlap; foot-vs-foot at +25deg suggests narrow rest stance

findings_resolved.what: rest_rot repose ramp parameterized by motion progress s(k)=pose_dist(T'_k)/pose_dist(T'_last) instead of clock t; per-keyframe 'repose' + part 'rest_rot_deg' emitted; PASS4/PASS3c conjugate truth about off_p by S @ slerp(I,D4,s) @ S^-1 (S=q_pred @ ramp^-1) -- exact, no commutator error.
findings_resolved.measured: 15deg synthetic rest_rot: repose completes at t=0.270 with deployment; PASS4 0.0000-0.0146m (phantom-free)
findings_resolved.caveat: no production asset uses rest_rot yet; verified only on synthetic override

findings_resolved.what: _rigid_se3(M)=LocRotScale(t, normalized q, 1) applied to carrier refs in W_rel/D_b_inv/spin rel_travel/group fit (worker) and ref0/refk in diagnose carrier_rel.
findings_resolved.measured: no buster regression (carrier has no scale keys); guards against squash/stretch roots on future assets

findings_resolved.what: PASS4 drops probe frames landing on baked stop frames (tautology); keyframes emit 'quat' [w,x,y,z] sequentially hemisphere-chained for direct runtime nlerp.
findings_resolved.measured: probe set now exclusively inter-stop; manifest size unchanged in fields consumed by 2-pose consumers

remaining_issues.issue: leg_l/r/leg_f non-rigid chains: endpoint_dev 0.31-0.47m is permanent deployed-pose error baked into the joined .ydr; fit centers it (~0.19m proximal / 0.64m distal tip at PASS3c) but cannot remove it
remaining_issues.fix: split each leg chain into 2-3 part_map entries (proximal/distal); needs max_parts >=18 (currently 16, buster at 15 groups)

remaining_issues.issue: 41 FK_SCISSOR_CLIP on mech -- unreviewed; could be real in-game plate clipping
remaining_issues.fix: visual review of knee/hip/foot plates at 25deg flex; either remodel plates or accept joint-overlap as design

remaining_issues.issue: weighted Kabsch (driver 3x) biases residual toward distal members to protect the mount seam; an asset where distal accuracy matters more may want weight=1
armature-deformed multi-member groups skip the fit (object matrices don't describe skinned verts); WARN_GROUP_FIT_SKIPPED_DEFORMED emitted
remaining_issues.fix: evaluated-vert probe sampling if a skinned multi-member group appears

remaining_issues.issue: 121 DISJOINT_KINEMATIC_SEAM on mech -- unchanged design noise from Phase 4, still unreviewed
remaining_issues.fix: manual review of Spine3<->Pelvis/Thigh hop patterns

knobs_added.assembly_config.group_fit: 'procrustes' (default) | 'driver' -- whole-group Kabsch trajectory fit for multi-member hinge groups
knobs_added.assembly_config.group_fit_proximal_weigh: 3.0 -- driver member weight in the fit (mount-seam protection)

manifest_fields_added.parts[].rest_rot_deg: recipe rest_rot override in degrees (only when nonzero)
manifest_fields_added.parts[].keyframes[].repose: motion-progress repose fraction s_k (only when rest_rot_deg present)
